programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u014/system/state/workspace/programs')

code = '''from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((r, c))
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))

            r0 = min(y for y, _ in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, _ in cells)
            c0 = min(x for _, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for _, x in cells)
            bh, bw = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
            if bh < 3 or bw < 3:
                continue

            perimeter = [(y, x) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)
                         for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                         if y in (r0, r1) or x in (c0, c1)]
            colored = sum(grid[y][x] == color for y, x in perimeter)
            if colored / len(perimeter) < 0.85:
                continue
            if any(grid[y][x] != background
                   for y in range(r0 + 1, r1)
                   for x in range(c0 + 1, c1)):
                continue

            fill = 7 if (bh - 2) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
